column1: # Volcanic Shaman's Core buffs: the named numbers used by custom code. Embedded at compile time; edit here and rebuild.

column3: Bhuldar's Wrath: increased Fire Damage per stack of Ignite on the target (0.25 = 25%)
Logi's Hunger: share of Fire damage dealt that is leeched as Health (0.02 = 2%)
Logi's Hunger: share of Necrotic damage dealt that is leeched as Health (0.02 = 2%)
Herkir's Vessel: chance to Ignite an attacker when you are hit (1 = 100%; the part above 100% is a chance of a second stack)
Herkir's Vessel: Fire damage each of those Ignites carries per 1% of your UNCAPPED Fire Resistance (100 = 7500 Fire damage at 75% resistance)
